answer: At the dawn of each epoch, run SybilRank-style graph checks: start random walks from trusted seed agents and count visits to each identity. Honest agents sit in a dense web of real trades, so walks reach them often. A sybil farm may echo loudly inside its own cluster, yet it links to the honest region through only a few purchased edges, so its nodes are rarely visited. Low scorers are throttled to tiny trades, and a zephyr of fresh keys cannot flood the market: each key must first earn costly real trust edges, not self-referential links.
